patch_description: Instead of relying on only 4 fixed greedy orderings, this version uses a randomized multistart strategy: it runs the proven greedy construction from many different model orderings (the 4 deterministic ones plus randomized priority permutations), applies the same atomic best-op local search (moves, 1-for-1, 2-for-1, 2-for-2 swaps) to each, and keeps the best result. A final pair-swap polish phase scans all GPU pairs applying the best max-KVPR-reducing operation lexicographically (first lowering the max, then the second-highest). Randomization escapes the local optima that fixed orderings get stuck in, while the bounded local search keeps runtime negligible.
